slot.brief: A single parallel-plate capacitor with given C and V; direct substitution into U = ½CV² (or ask energy density given plate area and separation).

stem: A capacitor of capacitance $5$ μF is connected across a $12$ V battery. How much energy is stored in it?
working:
$U=\dfrac12CV^2=\dfrac12(5\times10^{-6})(12)^2=3.6\times10^{-4}$ J.

Independent check: U = ½CV² = ½(5×10⁻⁶)(12²) = 3.6×10⁻⁴ J.
solution:
The energy stored in a capacitor is $U=\frac12 CV^2$.
$$U=\frac12(5\times10^{-6})(12)^2=3.6\times10^{-4}\ \text{J}$$
